_comment: Sonoff Zigbee smart water valve (battery). No native flow-meter cluster; the WaterCounter (incremental counter), Flow (L/min), WaterVolume (liters irrigated today) widgets are all computed from the fc11/501f irrigation status reports; fc11/5007 RealtimeIrrigationVolume is a per-session total re-reported on reads, so it is only stored. A manual On is a single irrigation session (fc11/501d) that the valve ends by itself after SONOFF_SWV_MANUAL_IRRIGATION_DURATION minutes (device default 2, max 719; set to 5 here). The TextStatus widget and the log show the decoded irrigation status (fc11/501f) on every change and otherwise at most every SONOFF_SWV_STATUS_REPORT_INTERVAL seconds. The Flow widget (L/min) is computed from the running fc11/501f reports over SONOFF_SWV_FLOW_RATE_INTERVAL seconds (default 60; the amount resolution is 1 L so a shorter window is noisier) and set to 0 when the session ends. The WaterVolume widget (Custom sensor, L) shows the volume irrigated today, computed by the plugin from the fc11/501f reports (sessions ended today plus the running one; the valve's fc11/500f DailyIrrigationVolume is only stored, it was seen not to follow the sessions). Optional Params: SONOFF_SWV_MANUAL_IRRIGATION_MODE (duration|capacity|duration_with_interval, the latter with SONOFF_SWV_MANUAL_IRRIGATION_TOTAL_DURATION 1-719 and SONOFF_SWV_MANUAL_IRRIGATION_INTERVAL 1-60 min, burst 3-60 min), SONOFF_SWV_MANUAL_IRRIGATION_AMOUNT (0-10000), SONOFF_SWV_MANUAL_IRRIGATION_AMOUNT_UNIT (liter|us_gallon), SONOFF_SWV_MANUAL_FAIL_SAFE (0-719 min), SONOFF_SWV_ALARM_WATER_SHORTAGE / SONOFF_SWV_ALARM_WATER_LEAK / SONOFF_SWV_WATER_SHORTAGE_AUTO_CLOSE (0|1), SONOFF_SWV_ALARM_WATER_SHORTAGE_DURATION (1-10 min), SONOFF_SWV_ALARM_WATER_LEAK_DURATION (1-3 min), SONOFF_SWV_WATER_FLOW_UNIT (liter|us_gallon|imperial_gallon, firmware >= 1.1.0), SONOFF_CHILD_LOCK (0|1), SONOFF_SWV_IRRIGATION_PLAN (dict or list of plans, irrigation_duration >= 3 min or the valve drops it silently), SONOFF_SWV_IRRIGATION_PLAN_REMOVE (plan index).
